title: Minimum insulin action time can't be set less then 5.0
body: Hi. I use Apidra insulin. Its effect lasts 3 hours. But in the AAPS application the minimum insulin action time can be set 5.0. How can this be fixed?

comments.body:
The AndroidAPS docs are really good and there is an answer for almost anything in there. 

Please take a look at the reasoning behind using a DIA of at least 5 h: https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/de/latest/Usage/Profiles.html#dia-3hr-too-short
Thank you for the clarification. It looks like the issue has been resolved.
